This is my sorghum plot, only a small piece of land close to the house. I will put a little fertilizer — maybe one bag of urea stretched across my plots — because the land here is tired and without it the sorghum gives poor heads. I also spread manure from my animals before the rains, which helps more than the chemical alone. I will use my own seed that I saved from last year; the hybrid seeds are costly and not suited for our weather. The plot is small so my sons and I can work it ourselves without hiring.
